content: संदृश् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To see, behold; धिङ्मां त्रिशिरसा नाऽहं संदर्शिष्येऽद्य यत् पुनः <ls>Bk. 16. 9</ls>. .²2 To see well or perfectly. .²3 To consider, reflect upon. .²4 To calculate, enumerate. .²5 To overlook, wink at. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} .²1 To look like, resemble, be similar. .²2 To become visible, appear. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To show, exhibit, discover; आत्मानं मृतवत् संदर्श्य स्थितः <ls>H. 1</ls>; <ls>Bk. 4. 33</ls>; <ls>M. 4. 9</ls>.
